title: The Gilded Trophy Oar
scene: At 3:25 PM, the gilded trophy oar vanished from the boathouse rack. The 3:00 PM riverboat takes 35 minutes to reach Willow Bend.

suspects.name: Nadine Abbott
suspects.testimony: I taped oar handles on the bench right beside the boathouse rack from 3:10 to 3:30 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two junior rowers sat with Nadine on the bench beside the rack from 3:10 to 3:30 PM.

suspects.name: Farah Mansour
suspects.testimony: I patched a kayak hull on the sunny lawn from 3:05 to 3:30 PM and never stepped inside.
suspects.alibiProof: A passing jogger stopped to chat with Farah on the lawn at 3:15 and 3:25 PM.

suspects.name: Hector Ruiz
suspects.testimony: I painted buoys on the outer dock from 3:00 to 3:30 PM, watching the geese swim by.
suspects.alibiProof: The harbor patrol boat waved to Hector painting buoys on the dock at 3:10 and 3:25 PM.

suspects.name: Quentin Blair
suspects.testimony: I caught the 3:00 PM riverboat and was already having tea at Willow Bend by 3:20 PM.
suspects.contradiction: The 3:00 PM riverboat doesn't reach Willow Bend until 3:35 PM, and the oar was under Quentin's tarp.
